basis: The dashboard explicitly displays only a selected subset of hospitals (as stated in the subtitle: 'Selected large-volume hospitals shown in dashboard summary'). The plotted relationship, while showing a positive correlation within this subset, does not establish causation or generalizability to the full hospital population. For an enterprise-level statement, which requires evidence applicable to the entire organization, this subset-level descriptive comparison is insufficient without broader population data.
option_label: Route this subset finding for full-hospital population review before enterprise approval
